title: Grateful Dead Live at Thelma Theater on 1969-12-12
source: Source Info: Master Soundboard Reels > Dat (16/44.1k); Transfer Info: Dat (Sony PCM-R500) > Tascam DA-3000 (.wav 16/44.1k) > Adobe Audition 3.0 > TLH flac16

ai_review.summary: Good‑quality soundboard composite with standout Alligator > Caution and organ‑rich Dire Wolf, though the show runs unevenly.
ai_review.review: The composite soundboard source is well balanced (with a slight pitch tweak) and captures the band clearly. Musically the night shines on the monster Alligator → Caution stretch and the organ‑laden take of Dire Wolf, while some early‑set numbers lose momentum. Overall listeners find it an interesting 1969 outlier that rewards repeated spins.

ai_rating.rationale: Four detailed reviews give a range of opinions; the strongest musical moments are praised while other parts are described as average, leading to a solid but not exceptional overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Composite of best sources, re‑pitched and balanced; early show runs slightly fast (≈-1% pitch correction) but generally clear and well mixed.

poor_songs: Next Time You See Me (stuck in the mud)
show_quality.setlist_flow: The concert is a bit uneven – the early set feels average with some tempo hiccups, while the late set builds to an impressive 30‑minute Alligator into a 24‑minute Caution, giving the night a strong second half.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Organ work (keyboard) on Dire Wolf and Uncle John's Band highlighted; his tone is praised.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keyboard/organ parts stand out, especially on Dire Wolf and the extended jams.
band_member_comments.Drums: Early drumming described as loose ('drummer's soup') but tightens up later in the set.
